$comment: How the unit-suite mutation run (config/mutation/stryker.config.mjs) is split across jobs. One job over all of src/core took almost exactly two hours on 14, 15 and 16 September 2026 and then stopped finishing at all: the unit suite grew from ~4,957 tests to 6,468, and with coverageAnalysis perTest every added test slows every mutant. The run of 2026-09-18 was still going at 3h35m against a 240-minute timeout. A nightly that never completes never saves reports/mutation/stryker-incremental.json, which is the baseline ci.yml's mutation-pr job restores — so the pull request gate mutated everything from scratch and timed out too (esi-23g.52).
$invariant: The shards partition the directories the unit run mutates, src/core and src/sde (Track S Run 2): every TypeScript file under them belongs to exactly one shard. tests/tdd/mutation-ratchet/unitShards.test.ts fails on a file claimed twice or not at all, so a shard boundary cannot quietly drop a directory from the run. The exclusions in config/mutation/stryker.config.mjs apply to every shard alike, so the union of the shards mutates exactly what the unsharded glob did.
$balance: Mutant counts are a property of the source and the mutator config, not of the test suite, so these are the same numbers measured for the BDD shards: requestPipeline 503, rateLimiter 401, pagination 231, circuitBreaker 193, cache 182, middleware 35. src/core/endpoints falls to core-root and contributes nothing, because config/mutation/stryker.config.mjs excludes it; claiming it anyway is what keeps the partition total. The sde shard instruments 1,317 mutants (src/sde with SdeTestDataFactory.ts excluded, measured 2026-09-27 with `npx stryker run config/mutation/stryker.config.mjs --mutate "src/sde/**/*.ts,!src/sde/SdeTestDataFactory.ts"`).
